provenance.notes: Chosen for the third Araṇya slot: Jaṭāyu’s dying words to Rāma (narrated scene at jatayu_glade). Printed with sandhi across the pāda break: आयुष्मन्नन्वेषसि (आयुष्मन् + अन्वेषसि, final n doubled after a short vowel before a vowel); shown here split at the word boundary with the doubled n kept at the end of pāda 1 (…आयुष्मन्न् | अन्वेषसि…, as IAST editions write āyuṣmann anveṣasi), so the sounds are identical. प्राणा = प्राणाः with visarga dropped before the voiced र् of the next pāda. Rejected alternative: Jaṭāyu’s "न तत्समाचरेद्धीरो…" (vulgate 3.50.7) differs between the editions (vulgate विपश्चिता vs critical विमर्शनात्, and a six-pāda vulgate form).
